intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Huntington Beach for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 15 (Christmas Market OC at Old World Village, through January 3) to the Cruise of Lights on the harbour (December 18 to 22), with the Yule Tide Tree Lighting at Pacific City (December 3), the Huntington Harbour Boat Parade (December 12 and 13) and Light a Light of Love on Main Street (December 6) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Huntington Beach

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Huntington Beach (4 already live, 1 moved over from the Irvine page and 3 new)
  • 5 free events: Christmas Market OC, Yule Tide Tree Lighting, Light a Light of Love, Santa visits at Pacific City and the Huntington Harbour Boat Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa Meet and Greet at Christmas Market OC and Santa's vintage Airstream at Pacific City
  • Trains and boats: the Village Train at Old World and the Cruise of Lights narrated boat tour (December 18 to 22)
  • Season: November 15 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Huntington Beach families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Anaheim, which covers Holidays at the Disneyland Resort, Knott's Merry Farm, Anaheim Ballet's Nutcracker and the Anaheim tree lighting.
